findings.rule: dmg = round(A * m * (1 - D/100) * (1 + dmgTakenPerAdd*n)), rounded once at the end. D = min(sheet totalDamageReduction + sum of active buff DR, 75) * (1 - damageReductionPerAdd*n). Sheet DR is the soft-capped 35.3, not raw 36.1. Buff DR: Iron Bastion L7 29.6, Warborn Fury L9 30, added, then capped at 75 before the Burden drain. Burden config: HARD dmgTakenPerAdd 0.1 and drPerAdd 0; NORMAL 0.2 and 0.13. findings.mechanic: Burden max HP, regen and healing (tank HP bookkeeping)
findings.rule: maxHp_n = round(sheetMaxHp*(1 - hpPerAdd*n)), with hpPerAdd 0.04 HARD / 0.1 NORMAL. On burden_update, HP = min(HP, maxHp_n), even while Iron Bastion is up (the IB bonus is ignored in this clamp). When n falls, HP stays and the cap rises. The regen pulse comes every 100 ms on the global grid whenever HP < cap. It heals round(sheetMaxHp*hpRegen%/100/10*(1 - hpRegenPerAdd*n)), using the unbuffed sheet max and not the burden max. hpRegenPerAdd is 0.05 HARD / 0.07 NORMAL. Healing reduction does not apply to regen. Lifesteal heals floor(dmg*lifesteal%/100*max(0, 1 - healingReductionPerAdd*n)), with healingReductionPerAdd 0.2 HARD / 0.25 NORMAL. It applies right after the attack row, so the attack row's snapshot is pre-heal, and it is capped at the cap. Order within a timestamp: spawn/burden/add_death, then player 0 (spells, DoTs, regen, attacks), then player 1 regen, then player 1 attack, then the boss swing or Judgment, then add swings.
findings.evidence: Full step-by-step reconstruction of Oria's playerHpsAfter: HARD 3157/3157 ticks, NORMAL 1123/1123 ticks. Regen pulses 59162 at n=0 (also while IB is up), 56204 at n=1, 53246 at n=2. Lifesteal 14917, 14284 (n=1), 8950 (n=2), 0 at n>=5 HARD (an unclamped factor goes negative and broke 4 ticks). Floor beats round for lifesteal (2 vs 44 mismatches before the IB fix). The only grid points with no regen are add spawns where the clamp leaves HP at the cap, and the fight end. OrionAF's caps follow the same rule: 2752013, 2637346, 2522678 (round, not ceil), 2178677. Her regen is 6450 at n=5 (8600*0.75).
